title: Expiry Date Extension Function — Crestline Flight Credits and Travel Vouchers
content:
**Subject.** This page covers extension of the expiry date of an active credit of Crestline Flight Credits and Travel Vouchers, and the function that records it. An active credit may be extended by the extension term when its instrument permits extension and the credit's extension count is below the instrument's maximum number of extensions.

## Recording condition

For a credit whose extension fee is not waived, the new expiry date from an extension is recorded only after the credit carries an extension fee entry dated on the day of the extension.

Equivalently: where the extension fee is not waived and the credit carries no extension fee entry dated on the day of the extension, no new expiry date from an extension is recorded.

## Capability

The extension function moves the credit's expiry date forward by the whole number of calendar months given. The months are counted from the expiry date the credit currently shows, keeping the same day of the month, or the last day of that month when the day does not exist. The function also raises the credit's extension count by one. The credit's value and status do not change, and the customer then sees the credit with its new expiry date.

## How it is invoked

The function is `extend_credit_f94665bb`. It is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it and then calls it.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `credit_id` | Reference number of the credit being extended, as returned by the credit lookup for this customer | identifier |
| `extension_months` | The length of the extension, in whole calendar months | integer of at least 1 |

## Return

On success the receipt carries:
- `status` — the word "extended";
- `credit_id` — the credit extended;
- `previous_expiry_date` — the expiry date before the call, in the form YYYY-MM-DD;
- `new_expiry_date` — the expiry date after the call, in the form YYYY-MM-DD;
- `extension_count` — the credit's extension count after the call, an integer.

## Receipt illustrated (hypothetical)

For a credit showing an expiry date of 2026-08-31 and an extension count of 0, a call with 6 months returns previous expiry date 2026-08-31, new expiry date 2027-02-28 and extension count 1. The values illustrate the contract only.
